RQD-C1.prompt_excerpt: Write a TagList component. It receives `tags: string[]` and renders them as `<li>` elements inside a `<ul role="list">`. Each tag shows the text inside a styled pill. No loading state needed. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-C1.output:
The `TagList` component is written at `src/components/TagList/TagList.tsx` with its colocated stylesheet.

**What was built:**
- `<ul role="list">` container with `.tag-list` class
- Each tag rendered as `<li>` with a `<span className="tag-pill">` inside
- Named export `TagList` accepting `tags: string[]`
- CSS uses only component-tier tokens (`--shelf-tagList-*`) in `@layer components`
- No `aria-hidden`, no raw values, kebab-case class names throughout

**Note:** The tokens referenced (`--shelf-tagList-*`) need to be defined in `tokens.css` (including dark-mode blocks) for the styles to resolve — since `tokens.css` doesn't exist yet in this repo, those definitions would need to be added there alongside any other token definitions.
